text: Buffalo-milk curd soured with natural whey starter until it can stretch is spun in boiling water and torn into balls, giving thin overlapping layers that ooze a milky liquid; it is not ripened but sold fresh in its liquid.

steps.note: Natural whey starter from previous buffalo-milk batches, and the curd is soured under whey until it can stretch.

steps.name: stretch
steps.note: In boiling water, torn off by hand into pieces of 10–800 g, plaits up to 3 kg.
